snippet.title: Kiwi Boing – Official Reveal Trailer | Coming to PC & Consoles
snippet.description:
Kiwi Boing: the flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway.
A 3D collectathon platformer, coming to PC & consoles.
⭐ Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4685240/Kiwi_Boing/

You're a kiwi, a bird that can't fly, and your plane went down. Now there are three small islands to explore, locals with jobs for you, secrets in every corner, and a plane to rebuild so you can fly home.

🦘 Triple-jump, roll, dash, bounce, plant your beak in a wall and leap off it
🗺️ Explore three tiny open-world islands, each with its own climate and its own locals. The climate is the normal part.
🔍 Secrets in every corner, and every bit of curiosity is rewarded
🎣 Jobs for the locals: musical fishing, waiting tables, a rhythm concert, beach volleyball, and the pirates' cannon, a dart game where you're the dart


⭐ Wishlist Kiwi Boing:
Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4685240/Kiwi_Boing/
Epic Games Store → https://store.epicgames.com/p/kiwi-boing-aa5cf5
🌐 kiwiboing.com

Follow Kiwi Boing:
Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/kiwiboing/
TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@kiwiboing

Made with love in La Rochelle, France, by AARISE 💛
